verdict.rationale: Claude Design is a SaaS design tool that could plausibly expose a public API, so this axis applies. The evidence pack shows no versioned API and no deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The only programmatic touchpoints are Claude Code slash commands and handoff bundles, which are not versioned APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
